card.name: Words right before "conflict"
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected "conflict" or "conflicts", such as a modifier (scheduling, armed, human wildlife) or "of" in "cases of". It also fires on the start of the word Conflict itself.

modes.label: Modifier before conflict
